messages.text: Also, I need a single, clear research question. "Is local better?" is too vague. Try: "What accuracy cost do we pay for on-prem inference in interest resolution?"
Okay, that's much tighter. I'll reframe the intro around that trade-off specifically.

And we need a baseline that doesn't use an LLM at all. Just the trigram + embedding pipeline. If you don't show the marginal gain of the adjudication step, reviewers will assume the model is overkill.
Fair point. We have the logs from when we tested the pipeline without the adjudicator. I can pull those numbers for the ablation table.
Good. One more thing: we need human evaluation. Automatic metrics aren't enough for a workshop like this. Can Noor recruit 10 students to label the edge cases?
I'll ask her. I assume you have a target venue in mind? The deadlines are moving fast.
Yes. There is an NLP-for-Education workshop with a full paper deadline of Fri 2 Oct. Abstracts are due Fri 25 Sep. It's the best fit for our audience.
Got it. I'll put those dates in the project tracker and start drafting the abstract today. Thanks for the push, Sofia.
